ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) background covering approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) markings providing localized high-contrast regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast markings are concentrated in the medial and basal regions of both lobes, consisting of white circular rings, irregular spots, and thin linear streaks against a dark field. The trailing edge regions maintain a higher density of low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; approximately 25-30 distinct peaks and valleys identified per lobe with irregular spacing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp upward convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered circular and annular high-intensity pixel groups (diameter range 5-15 pixels) distributed across the central portion of both lobes, consistent with scar tissue mapping.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional linear white streaks (rake marks) observed; notable intersecting lines forming an 'X' pattern on the lower-left lobe and parallel tracks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Protruding calcified clusters (barnacles) visible at both distal tips; distinct reddish-brown pixel cluster (lesion) on the upper-left lobe near the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct white ring pattern ('O' shape) on the right medial lobe and a high-density cluster of intersecting rake marks on the lower-left quadrant.
